# FlameMark

The product mark. Artwork, not a themed component — its gradient is fixed in both schemes, because a logo that changes colour is a different logo.

## Anatomy

Two paths: the outer flame carrying a vertical gradient, and the inner flame in the lightest stop.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `number` | `22, label` | — |
| `label` | `string` | — | Names the mark when it stands alone. Inside `Lockup` the wordmark names it instead. |

## Variants

None.

## States

Static.

## Tokens consumed

None — the component carries no styles of its own.

## Keyboard

Not interactive.

## ARIA

Decorative unless given a `label`. Inside a `Lockup` the wordmark names it, so it stays hidden.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.

## Reference correspondence

Carried over from `src/components/primitives/FlameMark.svelte` unchanged in geometry and colour. Its stops are stated in the markup rather than as tokens, because they are brand artwork rather than design values.

## Recorded deviations

None.
